title: Saving Student Data Decision Tool
description: Two questions, in order, applied to any field somebody wants to collect.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Club leaders designing a sign-up form

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a proposed data field, the learner justifies whether the club should collect it by walking through a minimal-data-first decision path.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Choose or type a field, answer the two questions, read the justified verdict
pedagogical.assessment: Justify a verdict on a field the tool has no stored answer for.
